hypotheses.question: Can Adaptive Closed-Loop Stimulation (ACLS) protocol reduce burst rate in CL Simulator?
hypotheses.prediction: ACLS will reduce burst rate by >20% compared to baseline within 30 min closed-loop session
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: Burst rate change <5% or increase after 10 min of ACLS
hypotheses.source_paper: ACLS in vivo validation (Patel et al.)

hypotheses.question: Can goal-directed learning (Cartpole) be demonstrated in CL Simulator using DishBrain-style encoding?
hypotheses.prediction: Agent will learn to balance pole for >100 steps within 50 episodes using burst-rate encoding
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: No improvement over random policy after 50 episodes
hypotheses.source_paper: Kagan et al. 2022 DishBrain; Robbins et al. 2025 organoid cartpole

hypotheses.question: Does burst-STDP protocol induce measurable synaptic plasticity in cortical organoids?
hypotheses.prediction: Post-pairing burst probability will change >20% from baseline and persist >30 min
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: No significant change in burst probability or firing patterns after pairing protocol

hypotheses.question: Does canonical STDP (pre-post pairing) induce LTP/LTD in CL1 organoids?
hypotheses.prediction: EPSP slope will increase >20% (LTP) for pre-leading-post; decrease >20% (LTD) for post-leading-pre
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: No significant change in EPSP slope or spike probability after pairing

hypotheses.question: Is learning in organoids transient (<45 min) or can it be consolidated with spaced training?
hypotheses.prediction: Spaced training (multiple sessions with rest) will produce learning persistent >2 hours
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: No difference between massed and spaced training; all learning decays within 45 min
hypotheses.source_paper: Robbins et al. 2025 (learning not persistent post-rest)

hypotheses.question: Can LFADS/GPFA latent dynamics predict burst onset >50ms in advance in real organoid data?
hypotheses.prediction: Burst prediction AUC >0.75 using latent state from LFADS on 8-channel organoid data
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: Prediction AUC <0.6 (chance level) for burst onset >50ms ahead

hypotheses.question: Does the contradiction-driven ResearchState loop identify more meaningful questions than random exploration?
hypotheses.prediction: Contradiction-driven questions will have >2x falsification rate vs random hypotheses
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: No difference in falsification rate between contradiction-driven and random

hypotheses.question: Do human brain organoids exhibit multi-channel network bursts (>3 channels within 5ms)?
hypotheses.prediction: Network burst rate >0.1 Hz with >30% of bursts involving >3 channels
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: Network burst rate <0.01 Hz or <10% multi-channel
hypotheses.source_paper: Organoid network bursts (Trujillo et al. 2019; Itatani et al. 2026)

hypotheses.question: Can stimulation artifacts be reliably rejected in real-time from HD-MEA organoid recordings?
hypotheses.prediction: Artifact rejection will achieve >95% specificity with <5% spike loss within 2ms post-stim

hypotheses.question: Do unit identities and firing properties drift across days in organoid recordings?
hypotheses.prediction: Unit match rate <50% across days; firing rate correlation <0.5
hypotheses.falsification_criterion: Unit match rate >80% and firing rate correlation >0.8 across sessions
